comments.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333 for contributing this fix and for the clear explanation and regression tests! We appreciate you taking the time to help improve Kiji Proxy.

I was working on a feature for TPU, and this fix unblocked me too. Thanks again!

I added two follow-up tests in [4d6a572](https://github.com/dataiku/kiji-proxy/pull/686/commits/4d6a5723ad7181288ac9080a6836720198674c28):

- Spans with no usable token offsets are left empty and filtered out, covering special/padding tokens, offsets past the end of the text, and reversed token offsets.
- A trailing token whose end precedes the first token's start is dropped while preserving the valid entity text and positions.

The full detector unit suite passes with these additions.
